dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to open a chest.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: As long as you've got some conches for me, you're free to take your pick.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Whoa there, wait a second. You can't just open these chests as you please.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: Of course. I placed them here specially.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: They're filled with all kinds of treasures, carefully gathered by me.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: If you want to open them, that can be arranged... However, first, you have to give me something in exchange.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: Hahaha, actually, I don't want any Mora.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: What I want is a kind of conch.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: You should be able to find plenty of them around the beach.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: If you want to open the treasure chests and get your hands on what's inside, bring me some of those conches in exchange.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: But... I'm not going to tell you what's inside. What treasures you end up with will come down to how lucky you are.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: What do you think? If you want to open these treasure chests, just hand me some conches.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are you a traveler? Haha, you've come at a good time. I have some good news for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does it involve these treasure chests?

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: That's right, it's the treasure chests.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: They're filled with all kinds of treasures, carefully gathered by me.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: For just a little something in return, you can open the chests and get your hands on the treasures inside.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: Hahaha, actually, I don't want any Mora.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: What I want is a kind of conch.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: You should be able to find plenty of them around the beach.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: If you want to open the treasure chests and get your hands on what's inside, bring me some of those conches in exchange.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: But... I'm not going to tell you what's inside. What treasures you end up with will come down to how lucky you are.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: What do you think? If you want to open these treasure chests, just hand me some conches.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Nice one! These are just the kind of conches I wanted. Go ahead, pick a treasure chest and open it.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: Sorry, these chests are one at a time, I'm afraid.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: Okay, go ahead and take your pick. Best of luck, hehe.

choices.text: Can't I open all of them?

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: I take it you've opened one of the chests? Hahaha, I hope you got lucky.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you're collecting these conches?

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Bingo. Yes, I am collecting them.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: But I can't tell you why for now.

choices.text: Is there something special about them?

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: From a business point of view, there most certainly is.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: "Conches that were once influenced by Tatarigami"... Hahaha, they're sure to fetch a good price!

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: Ahem! Anyway, you provide me with conches, I provide you with chests. Got it?

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: Anyway, that's your opportunity this time around used up.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: If you want to open another treasure chest, come back with some more conches later on.

response.speaker: Takashi
response.text: They're just conches for goodness' sake. Don't be so paranoid.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Go pick a treasure chest and open it. I wish you the best of luck.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Bye for now, then. Don't forget: conches for chests, conches for chests, hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: How's it going? Have you got some conches for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you collecting these conches for?

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Hehehe, well... to do some business, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: "Conches that were once influenced by Tatarigami"... Hahaha, they're sure to fetch a good price!

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Ahem! Anyway, you provide me with conches, I provide you with chests. Got it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This house looks familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: Is that so? Wow...that's quite a coincidence, hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: But even if the house looks the same, the business I do here is unique.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this? Huh... A conch? Paimon doesn't know what it's for, but... let's hold onto it for now.
